author: How It Should Have Ended
description:
How Toy Story 3 Should Have Ended Cartoon. Andy thinks twice when faced with letting go of his most favorite childhood memories, while Woody, Buzz and the Toys can't resist the chance to tell him how they feel. An animated alternate ending to the movie Toy Story 3.  Remastered from 2011 

Toy Story 5 is just around the corner! And Toy Story 3 HISHE is still one of our most watched videos even though it's stuck in old low res youtube!  So I cleaned up the original cartoon and Re-Rendered it in 4k for you to have the best picture possible on your screen.  Thank you so much for watching!
